train_bert_with_checkpointing: train a BERT model on GLUE MRPC with periodic step or epoch checkpointing via accelerate
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint folder with accelerated load_state and automatic epoch/step recovery
build_dataloaders_for_glue: build train and eval DataLoaders for the GLUE MRPC dataset with tokenizer-based collation and mixed-precision padding
run_accelerator_with_stateful_dataloader: run distributed training with a stateful dataloader for resumable checkpoint recovery across restarts
save_training_states_with_accelerator: save model, optimizer, scheduler, and seed states using accelerator.save_state at configurable intervals
